patch.value: changelog:check previously ran the prepend-mode generator with --check while CHANGELOG.md is generated in replace mode, so the gate could not be satisfied. Aligning it to changelog:full made it byte-identical to the existing changelog:full:check alias, leaving CI with two steps running the same command.
Duplicate changelog verification steps ran the same replace-mode check twice in CI
changelog:check and changelog:full:check resolved to the identical command after changelog:check was aligned to replace mode, and CI ran both as separate steps.
CI verifies the changelog exactly once, and no script alias resolves to a duplicate of another

patch.value: CI runs one changelog verification step and npm run changelog:check exits 0
The duplicate step and alias are gone and npm run changelog:check reports the changelog is up to date
Removed the duplicate changelog:full:check alias and its CI step, leaving a single replace-mode changelog gate

author: claude

patch.value: node -e "const s=require('./package.json').scripts; const c=require('fs').readFileSync('.github/workflows/ci.yml').toString(); const n=(c.match(/run: npm run changelog:check/g)||[]).length; if(s['changelog:check']!=='npm run changelog:full -- --check') throw new Error('changelog:check is not replace-mode'); if(s['changelog:full:check']) throw new Error('duplicate alias returned'); if(n!==1) throw new Error('changelog steps='+n)"
